mentions.name: BiamOS
mentions.description: This desktop app is an agentic workspace layer that runs web apps in a built-in Chromium webview with persistent sessions (Ghost-Auth), letting a local LLM interact directly with the DOM. The AI reads active context from services like Gmail, Notion, and Slack and generates a unified UI, turning fragmented SaaS silos into a single agentic dashboard. Built with Electron 34, React 19, Hono, and SQLite; currently early alpha.
mentions.problem: The workspace is still static and fragmented, requiring jumping between isolated SaaS silos instead of a single unified view.
mentions.source_excerpt: I spent the last two weekends hacking together BiamOS (https://github.com/BiamOS/BiamOS) because I’m tired of how static our workspace still is.
